title: Referrals & Prior Authorizations Terms Table: Rendering Provider, Site of Service and Consult Records
content:
Each Referrals & Prior Authorizations type carries fixed terms on who may render the service, where it may be performed, and how records move between the referring clinician and the rendering provider.

## Provider and site terms

| Referral type | Rendering provider may be changed on the existing referral (same specialty) | Rendering provider must be a Linden Ridge clinician | One second-opinion visit allowed | Service must be performed at the site named on the authorization | Change of the ordered service needs a new request |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| In-Group Specialist Referral | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No |
| HMO Specialist Referral | No | No | Yes | No | No |
| Standing Specialist Referral | Yes | No | No | No | No |
| Out-of-Network Referral | No | No | No | No | No |
| Physical Therapy Episode Authorization | Yes | No | No | No | No |
| Advanced Imaging Prior Authorization | Yes | No | No | Yes | Yes |
| Outpatient Procedure Prior Authorization | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## Records timing

| Referral type | Referral packet and records reach the rendering provider after approval (business days) | Rendering provider's report due back to the referring clinician after each visit (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|
| In-Group Specialist Referral | 1 | 14 |
| HMO Specialist Referral | 2 | 14 |
| Standing Specialist Referral | 2 | 30 |
| Out-of-Network Referral | 3 | 21 |
| Physical Therapy Episode Authorization | 2 | 30 |
| Advanced Imaging Prior Authorization | 1 | 2 |
| Outpatient Procedure Prior Authorization | 2 | 7 |

- A **second-opinion visit** is one visit with a different provider of the specialty, booked against the referral.
- **Ordered service** means the study or procedure code the order names.
- Business days run Monday to Friday with group holidays excluded.
